# WP-PWD01 Golden E2E mandatory evidence inventory v1.4
# AUDIT-R1 final offline QA trigger stamp: 2026-08-27 (no semantic change)
# Format: CLASS|RELATIVE_PATH_OR_SIGNAL|NONEMPTY|DESCRIPTION
# CLASS:
#   REQUIRED          = must exist before persistent Evidence Escrow starts
#   CONDITIONAL       = preserved when the platform exposes that exact file
#   GENERATED         = generated file inside the persistent/controller handoff bundle
#   CONTROLLER_SIGNAL = mandatory controller stdout/result signal after off-POWDER transport/verification

REQUIRED|sender/sender_summary.json|yes|Sender/run summary and frozen clocks
REQUIRED|sender/golden_manifest.json|yes|Golden run/environment manifest
REQUIRED|sender/attenuation_timeline.csv|yes|Q0/Q3 command start/end timestamps and attenuator IDs
REQUIRED|sender/telemetry_generated.csv|yes|Generated-record ledger with IDs/timestamps/checksums
REQUIRED|sender/queue_timeline.csv|yes|Application queue/replay trajectory
REQUIRED|sender/mqtt_events.jsonl|yes|Publisher transport/session event ledger
CONDITIONAL|sender/w1_queue.sqlite|yes|Required for W1 rehearsal; absent for architectures without durable queue
REQUIRED|receiver/telemetry_received.csv|yes|All receiver attempts with receive timestamps/checksums
REQUIRED|receiver/receiver_events.jsonl|yes|Receiver/session event ledger
REQUIRED|substrate/service_restore.txt|yes|G5 deterministic restoration console/timestamps
REQUIRED|substrate/service_ready_probe.txt|yes|G6 architecture-blind readiness proof
REQUIRED|substrate/core_start.console|yes|Profile-authoritative core/eNB startup command console
REQUIRED|substrate/ue_start.console|yes|Profile-authoritative UE startup command console
REQUIRED|substrate/core_tmux_capture.txt|yes|Complete available core/eNB tmux pane capture after rehearsal
REQUIRED|substrate/ue_tmux_capture.txt|yes|Complete available UE tmux pane capture after rehearsal
CONDITIONAL|substrate/epc.log|yes|Native EPC/MME/SPGW log when exposed by profile/runtime
CONDITIONAL|substrate/enb.log|yes|Native eNB/RAN log when exposed by profile/runtime
CONDITIONAL|substrate/ue.log|yes|Native UE/NAS/RRC/PHY log when exposed by profile/runtime
REQUIRED|runtime/core_runtime_fingerprint.txt|yes|Core/eNB runtime/config/code fingerprint
REQUIRED|runtime/ue_runtime_fingerprint.txt|yes|UE/application runtime/config/code fingerprint
REQUIRED|orchestration/golden_console.txt|yes|Top-level progress-visible G0-G10 console log
REQUIRED|orchestration/gate_events.jsonl|yes|Machine-readable gate transition/result ledger
REQUIRED|analysis/golden_reconstruction.json|yes|Machine-readable reconstruction from escrowed raw evidence
REQUIRED|analysis/golden_reconstruction.md|yes|Human-readable reconstruction report
GENERATED|escrow/SOURCE_SHA256SUMS.txt|yes|Source-node admitted-artifact SHA-256 manifest; internal hash authority
GENERATED|escrow/PERSISTENT_SHA256SUMS.txt|yes|Verified persistent /proj manifest copy
GENERATED|escrow/escrow_provenance.json|yes|Persistent run/experiment/source/destination provenance
GENERATED|escrow/PERSISTENT_ESCROW_GATE.PASS|yes|Verified persistent-copy marker
GENERATED|escrow/CONTROLLER_OFFPOWDER_REQUIRED|yes|Fail-closed handoff marker requiring controller pull/artifact round-trip before teardown
CONTROLLER_SIGNAL|CONTROLLER_PULL_GATE=PASS|yes|Controller successfully pulled persistent escrow and verified internal SOURCE_SHA256SUMS
CONTROLLER_SIGNAL|CONTROLLER_BUNDLE_SHA256=<64hex>|yes|Outer SHA-256 of deterministic controller bundle before artifact upload
CONTROLLER_SIGNAL|CONTROLLER_OFFPOWDER_GATE=PASS|yes|Independent controller artifact download/read-back verified
CONTROLLER_SIGNAL|ROUNDTRIP_BUNDLE_SHA256=<same_64hex>|yes|Round-trip bundle SHA-256 must equal CONTROLLER_BUNDLE_SHA256
CONTROLLER_SIGNAL|EVIDENCE_ESCROW_GATE=PASS|yes|Qualified off-POWDER evidence closure signal
CONTROLLER_SIGNAL|TEARDOWN_AUTHORIZED=YES|yes|May be emitted only after controller round-trip outer and internal hash verification

# Google Drive/rclone is optional secondary mirroring only and is intentionally
# absent from the mandatory/generated teardown-critical inventory.
